en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a river crossing at Nijmegen. In the foreground people in early 20th‑century clothing stand on a wooden landing with rails, one person holding a bicycle. A ferry barge and small boats are on the calm river, with low buildings and trees along the opposite bank under a lightly clouded sky. The printed caption at the top identifies the scene as the ferry over the Waal at Nijmegen.
